# Instructions for GitHub Copilot and repository-connected coding agents

This is the native Windows Go **MagicPatchDesk** Xbox patching project. Treat **[AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)** as the mandatory coding contract and **[PROJECT_CONTEXT.md](../../PROJECT_CONTEXT.md)** as the canonical handoff. Read **[docs/STATUS.md](../../docs/STATUS.md)** and **[docs/DECISIONS.md](../../docs/DECISIONS.md)** before proposing features already decided or completed.

The old entries in **[AI_HANDOFF.md](../../AI_HANDOFF.md)** and **[docs/PROJECT_STATE.md](../../docs/PROJECT_STATE.md)** are dated history, not current capabilities. Check live `main`, GitHub Releases and open Issues for newer information. No silent source overwrites, updater v1 breaks, unreviewed report promotion, or recurring Actions cost. Include an evidence-backed handoff update after each meaningful change.
